entry.name: barSize
entry.label: Bar size: small, medium or large. Scales the indicator glyphs (16/18/22 px), their text (11/12/13 px), the battery percentage (12/13/15 px) and, through the shell scripting API, the stock clock (Inter 12/13/15).

entry.name: magnify
entry.label: Magnify the indicators' glyphs (and the dock's icons, kept in sync both ways) when the pointer hovers them. The dock's magnification strength is the dock's own setting.

entry.name: showSpeed
entry.label: Show the live download/upload rate beside the network glyph while data flows.

entry.name: pollSeconds
entry.label: Seconds between probes while the pane is closed: each one is one small script (2 processes) that reads the kernel's network counters, Wi-Fi link quality, battery and backlight; the full probe (NetworkManager, Bluetooth, volume, power profile) runs every 30 s while closed, every 2 s while the pane is open, and right after each action.
